item.jerotes.sword: [Sword]Default - Can't break shield Can sweep attack
item.jerotes.whip: [Sword-Whip]Charges for a sweeping area attack - Increases Speed, Strength, and Haste effects on allied units struck by the charged sweep
item.jerotes.axe: [Axe]Default - Can break shield Can't sweep attack
item.jerotes.chainsaw: [Axe-Chainsaw]When used deals continuous %1$s times damage to creatures directly in front
item.jerotes.bow: [Bow]Default - Charge and release arrow - Arrow Speed %1$s - Default Projectile Range %2$s - Max Draw Duration %3$s seconds - Arrow Accuracy Deviation %4$s

item.jerotes.pike: [Pike]Default - Can't break shield - Attack type is lunge - Damage and knockback are based on both entities' speed - Can knock off riders and stop target's charge - Max Attack Range %1$s - Min Attack Range %2$s - Deals %5$s times damage, knocks back nearby enemies, and briefly blocks - Own Speed Multiplier %3$s - Enemy Speed Multiplier %4$s
